{{Liquipedia links|counterstrike=ScreaM (Belgian player)}} {{Players Tabs}} {{Infobox player |id=ScreaM |ids=ScreaMy |nicknames=Headshot Machine |image=ScreaM at the Masters Reykjavík 2022.jpg |name=Adil Benrlitom |givenname=Adil |familyname=Benrlitom |country=Belgium |country2=Morocco |birth_location=Brussels, Belgium |status=Retired |years_active=2020 – 2025 |birth_date=1994-07-02 |twitter=ScreaM_ |facebook=ScreaMdAK1nG |twitch=ScreaM |youtube=ScreaMy |instagram=screamdak1ng |faceit=ScreaM |vlr=92 |history={{TeamHistoryAuto}} |retired=2025-05-26 }} {{PlayerIntroduction}} He is a former ''[[counterstrike:ScreaM (Belgian player)|Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' and ''[[counterstrike:ScreaM (Belgian player)|Counter-Strike: Source]]'' player who played for various notable teams. On May 26th 2025, he retired and transitioned to ''[[counterstrike:ScreaM (Belgian player)|Counter-Strike 2]]'' after being signed by [[counterstrike:Main_Page|FUT Esports]]. He is Nabil "[[Nivera]]" Benrlitom's older brother. ==Biography== ===Professional Counter Strike Career (2010-2020)=== ScreaM was a star studded player who had one of the best headshot ratios in the history of any Counter Strike game. {{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/matches/2298571/envy-vs-titan-faceit-league-2015-stage-3|title=Envy vs Titan at FACEIT League 2015 Stage 3|author='''HLTV.ORG'''|date=2015-10-13}} He started playing Counter Strike: Source in 2010, and had been playing professionally until 2020. He was known for his time on a variety of French teams as an entry fragger, where his most recent achievements were on [[:counterstrike:G2|G2]]. While on the team, he helped them reach #2 in the world. {{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/ranking/teams/2016/july/4/5995|title=HLTV World Ranking on July 4th, 2016|author='''HLTV.ORG''''|date=2016-07-04}} ScreaM also was notably ranked the #7 and #9 in HLTV's top 20 player rankings in the years 2013 and 2016 respectively. {{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/news/11935/top-20-players-of-2013-scream-7|title=TOP 20 PLAYERS OF 2013: SCREAM (7)|author='''Tgwri1s'''|date=2014-01-14}}{{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/news/19610/top-20-players-of-2016-scream-9|title=TOP 20 PLAYERS OF 2016: SCREAM (9)|author='''Professeur'''|date=2017-01-12}} ===Professional VALORANT Career (2020-Present)=== Transitioning from a Counter-Strike legend to a Valorant professional started in Valorant's Beta, he played with [[Prodigy]], one of the top teams in Europe. The team won a variety of tournaments during the beta. In June 2020, he joined [[fish123]] as a stand-in, who later got signed by [[Team Liquid]]. {{cite web|url=https://www.teamliquid.com/news/2020/08/07/liquid-valorant|title=Liquid VALORANT|date=2020-08-07|author='''Team Liquid'''}} ==Gear and Settings== {{Mouse settings table |date=2024-11-03 |ref=[https://nightbot.tv/t/ScreaM/commands Scream's Twitch] |brand=Finalmouse |model=UltralightX Competition |dpi=1600 |polling=8000 |sensitivity=0.196 |zoom= |rawinput= }} {{Hardware table |date=2024-11-03 |ref= |mouse-brand=Finalmouse |mouse-model=UltralightX Competition |keyboard-brand=Razer |keyboard-model=Huntsman V3 Pro |pad-brand=SteelSeries |pad-model=QcK Heavy |headset-brand=Logitech |headset-model=G PRO X |monitor-brand=Alienware |monitor-model=AW2521H |refresh-rate=360 |w=1920|h=1080 }} {{Crosshair Table|sharecode=0;s;1;P;c;5;o;1;d;1;z;3;f;0;0t;6;0l;0;0a;1;0f;0;1b;0;S;c;6;s;0.949;o;1 |date=2024-11-03 |ref= }} ==Achievements== {{Player achievements table}} ==Awards== {{player awards table}} ==Trivia== *Nickname given as ''The Headshot Machine'' due the best headshot ratio ever achieved in a professional game of any Counter-Strike title.
